verdict.rationale: Mistral claims multilingual OCR across 40+ languages, and its OCR 4 announcement claims 170 languages with gains on low-resource languages. A hands-on test of a bidi English/Hebrew document contradicts this: the Hebrew output did not match the actual text and was instead a back-translation of the English, a concrete right-to-left fidelity failure. That test was on the earlier model, so OCR 4 may perform differently. Missing for 10: CJK-specific evidence, independent confirmation of RTL parsing fidelity on the current model, and per-script benchmarks showing parity with English.
